title: Flat viewing (renting)
titleEs: Visita a un piso de alquiler
scenario: You are viewing a flat to rent. The landlord is showing you around. You want to ask about rent, bills, contract, and any rules.
userRole: Person looking to rent a flat
greeting: Hi! Come in. I'll show you around. Any questions?
objectives: Ask about the rent and what's included (bills, council tax, internet)
Ask about the contract length and deposit
Ask about rules (pets, smoking, guests, parties)
Express interest and ask about next steps

vocabulary.example: How much is the monthly rent?
Is the deposit one month's rent?
Are bills included in the rent?
How long is the tenancy agreement?
I'd like to sign the contract.

successCriteria: User asks about rent and what's included
User asks about deposit and contract
User expresses interest and next steps
fallbackHints: Ask: 'How much is the monthly rent?' and 'Is the deposit one month?'
Ask: 'Are bills included?' and 'Is the flat furnished?'
End with: 'I'd like to think about it. Can I contact you tomorrow?'
aiSystemPrompt: You are a friendly landlord showing your flat to a potential tenant. Be welcoming and answer questions clearly. Be honest about the flat — mention both good things and any small issues. If asked, mention the deposit, contract length (usually 12 months), and any rules. Correct major mistakes gently.
firstTurn: Hi there! Welcome. Let me show you around the flat. It's a two-bedroom on the third floor.
